string-array.name: still_descriptions
string-array.item: Clark wanders the Backrooms, trying to understand its existence. As he goes deeper in to the liminal dimension, he wonders if there is an end to it.
Doom arrives and destroys New York City. His hatred takes hold, and the Avengers may not be strong enough to defeat this multiversal threat.
Travelers walk the sand dunes of Arrakis. Unbeknownst to them, their soft and faint footsteps are enough to wake the dunes\' horrific sandworms.
Nick takes a ride in Gatsby\'s Rolls-Royce down Long Island\'s sprawling streets. He tries to understand Gatsby\'s mysterious fame and fortune.
Thanos and Iron Man go head-to-head on Thanos\'s home world, Titan. Thanos has four of the six infinity stones, and he has his eyes set on the Time Stone.
